evidence.quote: We are committed to using our full range of tools to support the economy for as long as it takes until the job is well and truly done.
these one-time increases in prices are likely to have only transitory effects on underlying inflation
after looking at the details of Friday's disappointing employment report, the near-term outlook for the labor market appears to be more uncertain than the outlook for economic activity.
Notwithstanding the recent flow of encouraging macroeconomic data, the economy remains a long way from our goals, and it is likely to take some time for substantial further progress to be achieved.
we will continue to increase our holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month and our holdings of agency mortgage-backed securities by at least $40 billion per month
